items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And a lot of things happened that really should have been covered during that period... I will always remember some of the nights at Jack's Basket Room... there was Wardell Gray, Dexter... Just all on the bandstand, all through.

ctx.x: Yes, that's where they used to play all the top acts. I worked there with Howard McGhee with the big band that he assembled just for that date, that he and Gene Roland, the trombone player from Stan Kenton's band at the time, wrote all of the book.

But anyway, a funny thing happened. Sarah Vaughan... We have talked about it several times since that period. She came to Los Angeles with the Billy Eckstine band, and they played the Lincoln Theatre. Oh, that's when they had all the stars, you know, Dexter and Fats Navarro and everybody, Gene Ammons -- they had all the crew, you know. And, well, the people out here, they weren't really ready for that, you know. And there was a piano player and singer out here, and he was in the Army, called Private Cecil Gant.…
